scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix services/core install && npm --prefix services/forex install && npm --prefix services/notification install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix services/core run dev" "npm --prefix services/forex start" "npm --prefix web start" --names "core,forex,web" --prefix "[{time}] {name}:" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.start:docker-daemon: docker-compose up -d && echo 'Services running in background. Use docker-compose logs -f to view logs.'
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/core run test && npm --prefix web run test
